spans.s:
†तंस् तस् pour out (fig.);
 C. तंसयति shake.
—अभि shake out of, rob. परि C. shake, stir. वि the same. — Cf.
अवतंसय्.

2 त॑न् (only dat. & instr.) spreading, continuation,
propagation, offspring;
 instr. त॑ना (तना॑) adv. uninterruptedly,
continually.
3 †तन् तन्यति roar.
त॑न n. आ f. offspring, child.

तान m. thread, fibre;
 n. expanse.
तनयित्नु॑ a. roaring, thundering.
त॑नस् n. posterity, offspring.

त॑निमन् m. thinness, weakness;
 n. the liver.

त॑निष्ठ superl. & compar. to seq. तनु॑ (f. तनु,
तनू॑ & तन्वी) thin, slender, small, minute, little, spare (abstr.
˚ता† f., ˚त्व† n.), f. तनु or तनू॑ body, form, nature (abstr.
तनुता f.);
 person, esp. one's own person or self (often = a refl.
pron.;
 cf. आत्म॑न्). f. तन्वी a (slender) woman.
तन्निष्ठ a. intent on that.

त॑नीयंस् superl. & compar. to seq. तनु॑ (f. तनु,
तनू॑ & तन्वी) thin, slender, small, minute, little, spare (abstr.
˚ता† f., ˚त्व† n.), f. तनु or तनू॑ body, form, nature (abstr.
तनुता f.);
 person, esp. one's own person or self (often = a refl.
pron.;
 cf. आत्म॑न्). f. तन्वी a (slender) woman.
तनुगात्र f. ई slender (-limbed).

तनुज m. आ f. son, daughter (born from the body or
self).
तनुत्यज् a. giving up one's person.
तनूत्य॑ज् a. = तनुत्यज्.
तनुत्याग m. giving up or risk of one's own life.
तनुत्र n. armour, mail (lit. body-protector).
तनु˚त्राण n. armour, mail (lit. body-protector).
तनुधी a. of small understanding.
तनुभाव m. thinness, slenderness.
1 तनुमध्य n. the middle of the body, waist.
2 तनुमध्य a. having a slender waist.
तनुमध्यम a. = prec.
तनुवर्मन् n. armour (of the body).
तनुशरीर a. having a slender body.
तनूकृथ॑ s. preservation of body and life.

त॑नून॑पात् m. Agni or the fire (lit. son of one's own
self).
तनूपा॑ a. protecting body and life.
तनूबल॑ n. the strength of the body or self.
तनूरु॑च् a. brilliant in person.
तन्ति॑ f. cord, rope, line.
तन्ती f. cord, rope, line.
तान्ति f. choking, suffocation.
तन्तुभूत a. being the propagator of a family.

तन्तुमन्त् a. forming a thread;
 uninterrupted, lasting.
तन्तुवान n. weaving.
तन्तुवाय m. a weaver.
तान्त्र s. the music of a string instrument.

तन्त्रक* a. recent from the loom, quite new (cloth);
adj. —˚ doctrine, scientific work.
तन्त्रकार m. writer of a book, author.

तन्त्रय् तन्त्र˚यति keep up, perform, conform one's
self to, care or provide for (acc.).
तन्त्रवाय m. weaver.
तन्त्रायि॑न् a. drawing out a thread.
तन्त्रीस्वन n. time of a lute.
†तन्द् तन्दते relax, give way.
तन्द्र् C. तन्द्र॑यते grow weary.
तन्द्र॑ n. series, line.
तन्द्रा f. weariness, laziness.
तन्द्रयु॑ a. lazy, slothful.
तन्द्राय् तन्द्रा˚यते grow or be weary.
तन्द्री॑ f. = तन्द्रा.
तन्निमित्त a. caused by that, abstr. ˚त्व n.
तन्मनस् a. having the mind turned upon that.
तन्मांसाद m. eater of that flesh.
तन्मूल a. caused by (lit. rooted in) that.
तन्यता॑ (instr. f.) thundering, roaring.
तन्यतु॑ m. the same.
तन्यु॑ a. roaring, howling.

तन्वङ्ग f. ई slender (-limbed);
 f. a maiden or woman.
तानव n. thinness, meagreness, slenderness.

तानूनप्त्र॑ n. a cert. ceremony relating to Agni
Tanūnapāt ((r.)).

तान्त्रिक f. आ & ई familiar with or contained in a cert.
doctrine, esp. relating to the Tantras, mystical.
